shots.text: At Brazier Hold Ashwick came down the road himself, running, the way he always ran. He was born in Kethra. As a boy he swept Brannoc's forge; then he became the Concord's youngest messenger. Two years ago he ran east to the Rift, and nobody knew why.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ashwick stumbling on the steps of Brazier Hold, embers scattering off him, his empty messenger's satchel falling open. His grey eyes going dark.

shots.text: When he fell, we found Brannoc Emberhand, the smith who forged Solenne's gates, chained in his own forge. Ashwick had kept him there nine days to make him forge chains for the horde.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A cold forge. Brannoc Emberhand, huge, bald, brass-ringed beard, wrenching out of chains of his own iron and grabbing his hammer from the rubble; its head flares orange.

shots.text:
Nine days that boy asked me for chains. He used to sweep my floor.

Nine days I told him no. Now give me a wall to stand on.
shots.speaker: brannoc
shots.art_note: Brannoc on the wall of Brazier Hold, hammer on his shoulder, not smiling. Joins as a hero.
